title: OpenAI Academy 成立两周年：将 AI 技能带给更多社区
summary: OpenAI 发布文章，纪念 OpenAI Academy 成立两周年。该学院旨在向更广泛的社区普及人工智能技能，帮助不同背景的人群学习和应用 AI 技术。文章回顾了两年来的进展，并强调继续扩大 AI 技能教育覆盖范围的承诺。OpenAI Academy 是 OpenAI 推动 AI 普惠化的重要举措之一，通过提供学习资源和培训项目，降低 AI 技术的学习门槛，使更多个人、组织和社区能够受益于人工智能的发展。两周年之际，OpenAI 表示将进一步拓展该项目的影响力，让 AI 技能教育触及更多地区和人群。
summary_en: OpenAI marks the two-year anniversary of OpenAI Academy and reaffirms its commitment to bringing AI skills to even more communities. The initiative aims to make AI education accessible to broader audiences by providing learning resources and training programs. Over the past two years, OpenAI Academy has worked to lower barriers to learning AI and help individuals, organizations, and communities benefit from artificial intelligence. The anniversary highlights ongoing efforts to expand the reach and impact of AI skills education globally.
